name: HSBC Elite Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: $0 annual fee for primary cardholder and authorized users when the cardholder holds a Private Banking Account relationship at the time of application and on each subsequent account anniversary date to qualify for the annual fee rebate.

apr.notes: Variable Purchase APR 19.99% to 24.99% depending on creditworthiness; variable Balance Transfer APR 19.99% to 24.99%; variable Cash APR 28.99%. Maximum APR 29.99%. Transaction fee of $10 or 5% (whichever is greater) per balance transfer, check, or cash advance. Minimum interest charge $1.00.

credit_required.notes: Requires an existing U.S. HSBC Premier checking account to apply.

categories.label: Dining out and other travel purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Points can be redeemed for cash back as a direct deposit to an eligible HSBC Bank USA consumer checking or savings account, or as a statement credit. Rewards for Miles program allows transferring points into any of HSBC's 11 airline and 2 hotel partners' loyalty programs. Travel booked through HSBC Travel offers enhanced redemption value.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 Welcome Bonus Points, worth up to $900 in travel when booked through HSBC Travel, after spending $4,000 in the first 3 months of opening the card.

benefits.title: HSBC Travel Credit
benefits.description: Earn up to $400 of travel credits per year for all airfares, hotels and car rentals booked through HSBC Travel.

benefits.title: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Speed up airport screening with up to $120 towards Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, TSA PreCheck by Clear, or NEXUS once every 4.5 years.

benefits.title: Priority Pass Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary and unlimited lounge access for the cardholder and up to 2 guests worth more than $469 annually with Priority Pass.

benefits.title: Rewards for Miles
benefits.description: Rewards for Miles program allows you to transfer your points into any of HSBC's 11 airline and 2 hotel partners' loyalty programs.

benefits.title: MasterRental Coverage™
benefits.description: MasterRental Coverage™ provides rental car coverage when you use your eligible card to reserve and pay for the rental.

benefits.title: Complimentary Travel Insurance
benefits.description: Complimentary travel insurance coverage included with your Elite credit card.

benefits.title: Airport Concierge Services
benefits.description: Airport concierge services to assist with your travel experience.

benefits.title: Fine Dining & Designer Brand Discounts
benefits.description: Exclusive discounts and upgrades from fine restaurants and designer brands.

benefits.title: Rideshare Statement Credit
benefits.description: Earn up to $120 in statement credits annually on taxis, cabs and rideshare. Use your Elite credit card to pay for your rideshare and automatically receive $10 each month.

benefits.title: Instacart+ Membership
benefits.description: Get up to $140 annually with Instacart+. When you sign up as a new member, receive 3 free months of Instacart+ and $10 off your second order each month.

benefits.title: 24/7 Concierge Service
benefits.description: Unlimited concierge service - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. A dedicated personal service ready to assist you with travel, dining, shopping, entertainment, securing coveted reservations, and special perks and privileges.

benefits.title: Lyft Monthly Credit
benefits.description: Take 3 rides, and get a $5 Lyft App credit every month with your Elite credit card.

benefits.title: Purchase Assurance
benefits.description: Purchase Assurance covers most purchases from damage or theft within 90 days of purchase up to $1,000.

benefits.title: Cellular Wireless Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Claim up to $800 if your cellphone is stolen or damaged using Cellular Wireless Telephone Protection.

benefits.title: Mastercard ID Theft Protection™
benefits.description: Mastercard ID Theft Protection™ and Identity Fraud Expense Reimbursement provide support and expense reimbursement if your identity is compromised through identity fraud.

lounge_access.notes: Complimentary and unlimited lounge access for the cardholder and up to 2 guests.

other: Up to $400 annual travel credit for airfares, hotels and car rentals booked through HSBC Travel.
Rewards for Miles: transfer points to 11 airline and 2 hotel loyalty programs.
Airport concierge services and complimentary travel insurance included.

notes: Renamed from HSBC Premier World Elite Mastercard® Credit Card in early 2021. Available only to customers with an existing U.S. HSBC Premier checking account. Benefits valued by HSBC at over $2,900 in the first year and $2,000 annually thereafter. Issued by HSBC Bank USA, N.A.
